qr_mode_fields_check.name: qr_mode_fields_check
qr_mode_fields_check.value:
("qr_codes"."mode" = 'dynamic' AND "qr_codes"."link_id" IS NOT NULL AND "qr_codes"."short_link_id" IS NOT NULL AND "qr_codes"."static_payload" IS NULL)
       OR ("qr_codes"."mode" = 'static' AND "qr_codes"."link_id" IS NULL AND "qr_codes"."short_link_id" IS NULL AND "qr_codes"."static_payload" IS NOT NULL)

print_run_target_check.name: print_run_target_check
print_run_target_check.value:
("print_runs"."qr_code_id" IS NOT NULL AND "print_runs"."short_link_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("print_runs"."qr_code_id" IS NULL AND "print_runs"."short_link_id" IS NOT NULL)
